Let me start off with, I hate flies. I don't mean they annoy me or that I am not found of them. I loathe them to the point I will chase one through my house, wildly swinging whatever random item I grabbed, until one of us is dead. There has been much collateral damage over the years and the occasional non-combatant casualty but I consider these acceptable losses. I don't usually get a lot of flies in the house but even one is too damned many so I have several zapper fly swatters strategically placed throughout the house which ties into the "challenge" last night.

I got home from work yesterday, do my normal clothes change, grab a beer, plop down in my recliner and fire up the PC for some gaming routine. I use a 55" TV for my gaming monitor and when there is a fly in the house it will inevitably end up flying to the TV. So I'm sitting there and a fly goes right over my head to land on the TV. I immediately grab the zapper-swatter, startle the fly off the TV and with a satisfying POP, I zap that little bastard. I am not normally a cruel person but I have to admit I experience pleasure whenever I kill a fly.

Anyway, with my personal space once again free of the winged personification of everything that is wrong with this world I begin to settle back into my chair when another of the little fuckers flies right past my face. Woohoo! It's my lucky day because I get to kill 2 of the plague spreaders in as many minutes! With the 2nd herald of hell dead I once again start settling into my recliner when I see a 3rd fly land on the TV. OK, now I'm a little perplexed because even if there were 3 flies in my house the chances of all 3 being right in my face at the same time are pretty slim. I decide to finish my beer before taking care of the new arrival so, once it's empty, I get up to grab another one.

As I'm grabbing my beer out of the fridge a 4th fucking fly goes whipping into the fridge. Of course, like a fool, I'd left my weapon in the living room because I had not yet realized the scale of the conflict I was currently in. Since I can't zap it I watch to see where it lands. I track its path up into the light fixture and I think to myself, no beer for you until you kill that little fucker. I go get the zapper, go back into the kitchen and look up to see if it's still in there. The light in my kitchen is a 3' X 4' recessed box in the ceiling which houses the 2 fluorescent light fixtures. Instead of those solid plastic covers mine has a perforated grate so you can see quite clearly up into it. Well, the fly was still in there alright. It and (I shit you not) at least 30 other flies.

I have no idea where they came from or how they got in the house but I was just standing there with my mouth open, struggling to process what I was seeing. I do not leave food out, I seal any meat when I put it in the garbage and the weather hasn't been nice enough to leave any windows or doors open. My buddy thinks maybe something died in the attic and they came out from there but there's no smell of anything decomposing. Regardless of how they got in the house they were here and I was pissed. I don't have indoor bug spray and it's really hard to get the grate out of the light fixture so my only option was to take them out one by one as they came out. For giggles I would not let myself another beer until I killed at least 1 of the shit eaters and the worst drinking game ever was born. This went on for hours and as the night progressed it became increasingly difficult because as my beer count rose. I don't know how many I killed but it was at least 13 because I drank 14 beers total before I gave up and went to bed around midnight. On a typical Friday night I don't drink that many but I was on a mission and thoroughly enjoying myself.

TLDR: house was invaded by flies, would not allow myself a new beer until I killed at least one
